title: Human Risk Register (Ground Truth Extraction)
description: Contract for the HUMAN-AUTHORED register extracted as ground truth (data/ground_truth/<project_id>.json). Relative to output_schema.json (generation): likelihood and impact are OPTIONAL/null because World Bank PAD registers score risk with a single ordinal SORT rating rather than separate likelihood x impact; that ordinal is captured in sort_rating. mitigation may be null when the register rates a category but does not narrate a mitigation. There is no evidence field (evidence traces a model output to the planning doc and is generation-only). EXTRACTION RULE (formalized 2026-07-19 after recurring ad hoc calls on Albania, Nigeria, and others): a SORT category is text-driven, not rating-driven -- it gets its own risk entry if the Key Risks narrative names it ANYWHERE, even only inside another risk's mitigation clause, and even when its SORT rating sits below whatever threshold triggered narration for the rest of that document's risks. Conversely, a category rated Substantial/High with no narrative mention at all does NOT get a fabricated entry (see overall_sort_rating and notes for how un-narrated rated categories are recorded instead: as document metadata, not as a risks[] entry). This rule exists so the same document, extracted twice, produces the same register regardless of who does the extraction.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project, matching data/corpus_manifest.csv.

source.description: Document type the register was extracted from, e.g. PAD.

register_location.description: Where in the source document the register lives (for the leakage audit trail).

overall_sort_rating.description: The register's overall SORT rating (the 'Overall' row), kept at top level rather than as a discrete risk.

risks.description: One entry per risk in the human register.

notes.description: Extraction methodology notes for this project (e.g. text-driven vs. rating-driven decisions, which SORT categories were narrated vs. omitted). Audit trail only, not scored.

risk_id.description: Stable identifier unique within this register, e.g. R01, R02.

description.description: The risk as stated/summarized from the register (SORT category + Section V narrative where elaborated).

category.description: Mapped onto the 8 generation-schema categories where possible, plus 'other' for ground-truth risks that do not fit any of the 8 (e.g. a WB SORT 'Other' row with a genuinely populated, distinct risk narrative). 'other' exists ONLY in this ground-truth schema, not in output_schema.json (the frozen generation contract) - a ground-truth risk categorized 'other' is therefore a risk no model can ever match by category, which is itself a relevant RQ3 data point.

sort_rating.description: The register's ordinal SORT rating for this risk category.

likelihood.description: 1-5 if the register states/decomposes it; null for WB SORT registers (single ordinal only).

impact.description: 1-5 if the register states/decomposes it; null for WB SORT registers (single ordinal only).

mitigation.description: The stated mitigation from Section V, or null when the register rates the category but narrates no mitigation.
